declare class BaseError { constructor(message: string, options?: object); }
const identifier = 'AccountNotFound';
const named = new BaseError('boom', { identifier: 'AccountNotFound' });
const shorthand = new BaseError('boom', { identifier });
const independentStatus = new BaseError('boom', { identifier: 'X', statusCode: 404 });
const unnamed = new BaseError('boom', { statusCode: 500 });
const quotedKey = new BaseError('boom', { 'identifier': 'X' });
const computedKey = new BaseError('boom', { ['identifier']: 'X' });
